Sequence read count for this detection (organismQuantityType is 'DNA sequence reads' for all 201 rows, confirmed); becomes obs.measurement_value under measurement_type='sequence_reads'
Molecular marker, recoded to a short display label: 'D-loop' stays 'D-loop'; '12S rRNA (SSU mitochondria)' becomes '12S (MiFish)'. Written to obs_attribute.bin_label under measurement_type='assay'.

11 of ~60 distinct source measurementType strings map to a sample_measurement type via emof_type_map (6 reuse existing canonical types: ammonia/nitrate/nitrite/phosphate/silicate/chl_fluor; 5 are new: oxygen_mg_l/dna_concentration/reads_raw_total/reads_filtered_total/otu_richness). The other ~50 are FAIRe-checklist protocol text (kit names, SOP links, extraction dates) with no value/unit and are dropped.

TRY_CAST to DOUBLE; deduped to one value per (parentEventID, measurement_type) via MIN() -- a tie-break over identical values, confirmed identical across every eventID child of a parentEventID for all 47 groups, not an aggregation
